denylist.reason: audited equivalent mutant: turning this '||' into '&&' changes no observable behaviour. The arms are (a) the path is a symlink and (b) the path is not a regular file, and lstat reports a symlink as BOTH, so the symlink case still rejects under '&&'. The only case '&&' lets past this pre-check is a non-symlink irregular path (a FIFO or a directory), which openWorktreeLifecycleLockFile then rejects with the same 'not a regular file' error - see TestLockWorktreeLifecycleRejectsNonRegularLockFile, which passes either way. The pre-check is deliberate defence in depth ahead of the open, so the redundancy is the point and the mutant is equivalent rather than uncaught.
